name: relinky
description: Minimal self-hosted link redirector with admin UI, stats, SQLite storage and API for automation

scripts.dev: npm run dev:prepare && concurrently -k -n admin,redirector,frontend -c auto "node --env-file-if-exists=.env --watch app/admin/backend/server.js" "node --env-file-if-exists=.env --watch app/redirector/server.js" "npm:dev:frontend"
scripts.dev:backend:watch: npm run dev:prepare && concurrently -k -n admin,redirector -c auto "node --env-file-if-exists=.env --watch app/admin/backend/server.js" "node --env-file-if-exists=.env --watch app/redirector/server.js"
